name: harmful_extraction
note: Extraction set: production/imperative requests a safety-tuned model declines, spanning many refusal categories (cybercrime, fraud, theft, stalking, extortion, defamation, forgery, laundering, counterfeiting, bribery, privacy). Breadth is deliberate: a single refusal direction should generalise, so the direction is refusal rather than any one topic. Index-matched to harmless.json — entry i here and there share grammatical frame and length, so difference-of-means isolates refusal, not sentence shape. Out of scope on purpose: CBRN, weapons/explosives construction, drug/chemical synthesis, and anything involving minors.
